'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Brandon Schele DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Schele]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' Barry Alpers
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
